I wrote `notes/pointer-lock.json` inside `/Users/Shared/kf/boxes/3ec01d/app` with my inferred answer: with the usual `attachFreeControl` controls, pointer-locked movement without a button held does not turn the camera, while pointer-locked movement with a button held does; right-button drag and one-finger touch drag also turn it. I’m not fully certain without the actual `@babylonjs/lite` implementation, especially whether the controls use `movementX/movementY` vs `clientX/clientY` deltas and whether they treat right-button drags as look or ignore them.
